title: Karol G Unveils Dates for Global 2026 Viajando Por El Mundo TropiTour
summary: The world tour is in support of Karol’s latest album, Tropicoqueta, which debuted at No. 1 on Top Latin Albums Chart.
contentText:
On the heels of a historic headlining set at the 2026 Coachella Valley Music & Arts Festival, Karol G announced the dates for her new world tour, Viajando Por El Mundo Tropitour, on Tuesday (April 21).

Promoted by Live Nation, the 39-date outing (with more shows to be announced later) will kick off with the North American leg on July 24 at Soldier Field in Chicago. The Colombian star will then jump from stadium to stadium including SoFi Stadium in Los Angeles, MetLife Stadium in New York, and Hard Rock Stadium in Miami, before heading to Latin America and then Europe — where she will make pit stops in Mexico, Argentina, Brazil, Spain, England, and Italy, to name a few — throughout the rest of 2026 and the beginning of 2027.

The global Tropitour is in support of Karol’s latest album, Tropicoqueta , which debuted at No. 1 on Top Latin Albums Chart last June. The stint also follows her 2024 Mañana Será Bonito record-breaking tour, which grossed $313.3 million and sold 2.3 million tickets over 65 shows, according to figures reported to Billboard Boxscore .

View this post on Instagram

Karol broke the big touring news after wrapping her headlining Coachella set on Sunday, April 17. “Nos vamos de tour,” read the large screens at the festival. 

“Over the past six months, a large part of my life revolved around this moment,” the artist reflected in an Instagram post . “Every day, every decision, every effort, and every sleepless night shared a single purpose: to deliver something worthy of representing our people — and everything we have always dreamed of showing the world.”

Tickets for Viajando Por El Mundo Tropitour go on sale Monday, April 27. For more information, click here .
